notes:
plant-finder-list-sweeps (2026-11-12). 25 plant rows (22 base, 3 excluded: Pacific Steel Structures, Mid-Park, Stella-Jones). All quotes re-checked against fetched page text (AISC rows against the Playwright scrape).
SOURCES: AISC directory scraped fully (1881 certified companies, 95 pages); the 'Highway Component Manufacturer' filter dropdown did not filter via script, so all rows were read and the 253+ HCM rows filtered locally. HCM is a general highway-component certification (many bridge/misc-steel shops); only companies with a product claim from a DOT list or own site were recorded. State DOT lists used: GDOT QPL-52 and QPL-57, MassDOT approved fabricators, WisDOT Electrical QPL 657.0300, PennDOT approval letters (Structures USA, Maico), ODOT certified signal supports (Valmont only). TxDOT tsp.pdf and itspoles.pdf returned 404. Trade buyer guide (T&D World directory) page is JS-loaded and gave only sponsored items. OSHA file absent. USAspending/SAM/EPA FRS not queried (time). 
CAVEATS: coordinates for Grid Structures, Metal Pros, Arcosa Traffic Structures, Nucor x4, Hapco OKC, Stella-Jones are city-level (Nominatim + Census county), street address unknown. Nucor Decatur plant is called Trinity, AL in a SteelOrbis story; Nucor West Hazleton (Summit) id uses the 'Hazleton' spelling from Nucor's own statement; other agents may use different city slugs for these Nucor plants, dedupe by name+county. Structural and Steel Products also has a Crowley TX AISC-listed site and a 3900 Lubbock Ave address on GDOT QPL-57; only the Pafford St plant recorded. Not recorded for lack of own-site verification: Specialty Fab (North Lima OH, reportedly renamed Bird Equipment 2015), L&M Fabrication (Bath PA, general structural fabricator; MassDOT list only), TAPP (Texas, plant address not found), Falcon Steel America (Haltom City, lattice focus), Pelco Structural (Claremore OK, other agent), Resilient Structures (composite, out of scope), GSI Highway, Flagpoles Inc/P&K Tubular. Welder postings: only checked on each company's own careers page; most recorded as unknown.
